Title: fix(qdrant): aquery() drops falsy shard_identifier values (e.g. 0)
Notes: The async Qdrant query ignored shard_identifier=0 because the condition checked whether it was truthy. The fix checks for None instead.

Title: fix(ag-ui): do not persist frontend tool results server-side
Notes: AG-UI saved frontend tool results as server-side replies. This marked the tool call as resolved, so the client never executed its frontend handler. The fix saves only backend tool results server-side.

Title: fix: better error message for llm metadata extractor
Notes: LLMMetadataExtractor accessed variables[0] when the prompt had no variables, causing an unintended IndexError. The fix validates the prompt and raises a clear ValueError.

Title: fix(bedrock-converse): ensure thinking_delta is populated in all chat modes
Notes: Bedrock Converse did not populate thinking_delta in some chat responses. The fix extracts the thinking text and returns it in that field across chat modes.

Title: fix: Use the indexed metadata field 'ref_doc_id' instead of 'doc_id' during deletion.
Notes: PGVector deletion filtered on the wrong metadata field, doc_id, so matching documents could remain. The fix uses ref_doc_id in both sync and async deletion.

Title: fix(chroma): support multimodal results
Notes: Chroma retrieval set text on a reconstructed node using set_content, which did not preserve multimodal results correctly. The fix passes text to metadata_dict_to_node when rebuilding the node.

Title: fix: distinguish empty string from None in MediaResource.hash
Notes: MediaResource.hash treated empty text ("") like missing text (None), producing the same hash. The fix gives empty text a distinct marker.

Title: fix: Better HITL tool execution decision and tool call consistency
Notes: The human-in-the-loop strategy could associate an execution decision with the wrong tool call. The fix binds each decision to the tool call being processed by its ID.

Title: fix: pagination error too many values to unpack
Notes: Malformed page range such as 5-10-15 was split into too many parts and raised an unhelpful ValueError; the utility now validates the range.

Title: fix: don't raise IndexError when a stream emits no chunks
Notes: A stream with no chunks reached unguarded first/last chunk reads and raised IndexError; empty streams now return an empty chat message.

Title: fix!: require unsafe loading for serialized Jinja filters
Notes: Pipeline deserialization previously allowed Jinja custom filters to execute code without requiring unsafe=True. The taxonomy has no specific security symptom.

Title: fix: Fix `"text"` Agent exit condition
Notes: An empty assistant message after an invalid tool call met the Agent text exit condition and ended the loop prematurely; it now waits for non-empty assistant text.

Title: fix: update `Multiretriever` params
Notes: MultiRetriever forwarded ranking/filter parameters incorrectly and applied top_k at the wrong stage; the fix forwards per-retriever settings and truncates merged results.

Title: feat(confluence): make SVG processing optional to fix pycairo install…
Notes: Confluence reader installation failed when the svglib dependency pulled in pycairo build requirements; the merged diff restricts svglib below 1.6.

Title: fix(chunking): Ensure correct handling of multi-byte characters during AST node chunking
Notes: AST byte offsets were applied to Python character strings, corrupting chunks around multibyte characters; the fix slices encoded bytes before decoding.

Title: fix:(embeddings-bedrock) correct extraction of provider from model_name
Notes: Bedrock embedding provider extraction treated a region prefix as the provider, causing Provider not supported errors for regional model names.

Title: fix(qdrant): Allow async-only initialization with hybrid search
Notes: QdrantVectorStore hybrid initialization dereferenced a missing sync client in async-only mode, raising AttributeError; it now guards sync checks.

Title: fix(nvidia-rerank): fix initialization logic for on-prem auth
Notes: NVIDIA reranker treated an on-prem endpoint with a real API key as unauthenticated, omitting required headers; auth selection now checks the key or hosted flag.

Title: fix(agent): Handle multi-block ChatMessage in ReActAgent
Notes: ReActAgent.finalize accessed ChatMessage.content on a multi-block response, which raises ValueError; it now edits the TextBlock directly.

Title: fix(core): structured_predict() returns default values for single-field models
Notes: Structured prediction passed a single non-dict tool argument positionally but failed to map it to the model field, returning the Pydantic default instead of the LLM value.

Title: fix: Align start, end, and probability lists in ExtractiveReader
Notes: ExtractiveReader filtered start/end span lists but not probabilities, causing zip strict-length ValueError on short inputs; it now filters all three together.

Title: Fix: Reduce issues when parsing "Thought/Action/Action Input" completions (#12699, #14736)
Notes: The ReAct agent system prompt did not require Action Input when a tool had no kwargs, so model completions could be unparsable; the runtime prompt now requires an empty JSON object.

Title: Fix chroma nested metadata filters
Notes: Chroma filter translation assumed every nested filter had an operator field, raising AttributeError; recursive handling now translates nested boolean filters.

Title: fix: telemetry decorator overwrites original function metadata
Notes: The telemetry decorator did not preserve wrapped function metadata such as name, docstring, and annotations; functools.wraps restores it.

Title: fix: resolve \$defs/\$ref in tool schemas for HuggingFace API
Notes: HuggingFace API rejected tool schemas containing $defs/$ref; the integration now resolves references before sending tool parameters.

Title: fix: reject reserved output names in LLMMessagesRouter
Notes: LLMMessagesRouter accepted reserved output names that collided with built-in sockets, overwriting or conflating routed outputs; it now rejects those names.

Title: fix: create table with pre-defined schema
Notes: LanceDBVectorStore table creation/opening logic mishandled missing tables and pre-defined schemas; the fix defers creation and checks table availability.

Title: fix: add standard split metadata when DocumentSplitter uses split_by="function"
Notes: Custom DocumentSplitter output omitted split_id and other standard metadata, causing SentenceWindowRetriever to raise ValueError; it now uses shared split-document creation.

Title: Properly raise errors from docstore -- Fix Vector Index Retrieval
Notes: Vector retrieval fetched absent nodes from docstore without tolerant handling; missing replacements disrupted retrieval. The fix uses raise_error=False and keeps original nodes.

Title: fix(bedrock-converse): serialize rich content blocks in tool results
Notes: Bedrock Converse serialized tool results from the legacy text field and silently dropped DocumentBlock/ImageBlock content; it now serializes message blocks.

Title: fix: pass timeout parameters to transport clients in BasicMCPClient
Notes: BasicMCPClient did not pass configured timeouts to SSE/streamable HTTP transports, so slow tools timed out at transport defaults.

Title: fix: preserve constant scores in DocumentJoiner
Notes: DocumentJoiner distribution-based rank fusion normalized equal or single-document scores to zero, erasing valid scores; it now preserves constant scores.

Title: fix auto tool caching in bedrock-converse
Notes: Bedrock Converse auto tool caching placed separate cache points on tool specifications; the fix uses one cache point for the tool-spec set.

Title: fix: confirmation strategies no longer bake stale tool args
Notes: HITL confirmation baked state-derived tool arguments before earlier tools updated state, causing dependent tools to run with stale values.

Title: fix(lancedb): paginate table existence checks
Notes: LanceDB table existence checks inspected only the first page of table names, falsely treating later tables as absent; the fix paginates.

Title: fix(dashscope): remove empty tool_calls from assistant messages
Notes: DashScope requests included empty tool_calls for assistant messages, which some endpoints rejected; the field is now omitted when no calls exist.

Title: fix: sqlite chat store compatibility with sqlalchemy 1.4
Notes: SQLiteChatStore used SQLAlchemy 2-only APIs despite allowing SQLAlchemy 1.4, causing import/use failures; the fix handles both versions.

Title: fix(tools/mcp): correct streamable-http tuple unpack for mcp 2.0 (#22655)
Notes: MCP 2.0 streamable_http_client returns two values but BasicMCPClient unpacked three, raising ValueError on connection.

Title: fix: bound log field sizes to stop exceptions leaking payloads
Notes: Logging used repr(UnicodeDecodeError), exposing a large input buffer in logs and exceeding log-shipper limits; the formatter now bounds values.

Title: Fix: Add follow_redirects=True to GitHubIssuesClient to handle GitHub…
Notes: GitHubIssuesClient did not enable redirects in httpx.AsyncClient, so renamed/case-varied GitHub repositories failed to load.

Title: fix(litellm): Fix critical context window calculation
Notes: LiteLLM get_max_tokens gives output-token limit, but LlamaIndex used it as total context size, leading to negative available context and ValueError.

Title: fix: close file handles and http connections in reader integrations
Notes: Reader/retriever integrations left files and HTTP connections open, eventually causing Too many open files; the fix closes resources on exit.

Title: Fix/google genai cleanup
Notes: Google GenAI file-mode chat/streaming did not clean up uploaded files after failures or early stream closure; try/finally now deletes them.

Title: fix(azure-openai): use deployment name in AzureOpenAIResponses structured predict
Notes: Azure structured_predict sent the model family name instead of the deployment name to responses.parse, producing 404 DeploymentNotFound.

Title: fix: Fix State restoration in Agent from a `before_run` hook
Notes: An Agent restored step_count in before_run but failed to sync its execution counter, restarting at the wrong step.

Title: fix: ensure full docstring is used in FunctionTool
Notes: FunctionTool used only part of the function docstring when constructing the tool description; the fix retains the full docstring.

Title: fix: fix agent tool spans not getting nested under each other
Notes: Parallel agent tool trace spans incorrectly nested under sibling tools because each read the current span; the fix passes a shared parent span.

Title: fix: add system prompt to memory and use it also for structured generation
Notes: Agent system prompt was omitted from chat memory and structured generation, so those paths lost its instructions; the PR adds it to both.

Title: fix: McpToolSpec fetch all tools given the empty allowed_tools list
Notes: McpToolSpec treated an explicitly empty allowed_tools list as no filter and returned all tools; it now returns no tools.

Title: fix(azure-inference): properly manage async client lifecycle to prevent unclosed sessions
Notes: Azure inference integration kept async clients/sessions open, causing unclosed-session warnings and resource leaks; the fix manages client lifecycle.

Title: Fix BedrockConverse streaming token counting by handling messageStop …
Notes: Bedrock Converse streaming ignored messageStop/metadata usage events, so token counts were zero or absent; the fix emits usage from those events.

Title: fix: gemini tool request ids
Notes: Gemini tool IDs were assigned from the tool name, colliding for parallel calls to the same tool.

Title: fix: handle enum types in _resolve_union_option for Literal unions
Notes: MCP union schema resolution treated Literal enum options as strings.

Title: fix: pass **kwargs to super().__init__ in BaiduVectorDB to ensure pro…
Notes: Baidu vector store dropped constructor keyword arguments needed by the Pydantic parent.

Title: fix: FTS index recreation bug on every LanceDB query
Notes: LanceDB index creation returns None, so the old state check rebuilt FTS on every query.

Title: fix: skip overlap-only trailing chunks in character-based split modes
Notes: Document splitting emitted redundant trailing chunks containing only overlap.

Title: Fix: remove ORM Collection mix-usage with MilvusClient in Milvus vector store
Notes: Milvus vector store mixed incompatible ORM Collection and MilvusClient operations.

Title: fix(bug):Raise value error on when input is empty list in mean_agg instead of returning float
Notes: Mean aggregation of an empty embedding list returned nan instead of a valid embedding or clear error.

Title: fix: fix serialization of `State` and `PipelineSnapshot`
Notes: State and PipelineSnapshot serialization passed through unsupported values or failed on a single field.

Title: fix: handle empty corpus after metadata filtering in BM25Retriever
Notes: BM25 retrieval crashed when metadata filters removed the entire corpus; it now reports the empty result clearly.

Title: fix(dashscope): send query_history in retriever payload
Notes: DashScope retriever sent query_hisory instead of query_history in its payload.

Title: fix google genai thought output while streaming
Notes: Gemini streaming emitted thought text as visible response content.

Title: Fix/consistency level param for milvus
Notes: Milvus collection creation omitted the configured consistency_level parameter.

Title: fix(cohere-rerank): add retry logic and tenacity dependency to cohere rerank
Notes: Cohere reranker did not retry transient 500/503/504 service failures; PR prose calls it Embedding but changed reranker code.

Title: fix llm deps for openai
Notes: OpenAI integration package constraints were stale after a dependent package version change.

Title: fix(falkordb): Fix MENTIONS relationship creation with triplet_source_id
Notes: FalkorDB MENTIONS relationship was not created for entity nodes carrying triplet_source_id.

Title: fix: make get_cache_dir() function more secure
Notes: Cache directory selection used potentially world writable paths; taxonomy has no specific security symptom.

Title: fix: improve meta collisions in Document serde
Notes: Document metadata keys colliding with fields were lost during flattened serialization.

Title: Fix stale/rouge deps
Notes: OPEA packages constrained llama-index-core to an incompatible version range.

Title: `llama-index-embeddings-azure-openai`: fix typo of the if branch of get `api_key` if not use azure_ad
Notes: Azure OpenAI embedding API key lookup used the wrong Azure AD condition.

Title: Fix bugs in tool calling for OCI generative AI Llama models
Notes: OCI model tool calling misformed Cohere provider requests.

Title: fix: don't strip `title` when it is a name, not a schema keyword
Notes: Tool schema cleanup deleted user keys named title inside named maps or default values.

Title: fix(agent): handle empty LLM responses with retry logic and add test cases
Notes: ReAct agent raised ValueError on an empty model response instead of retrying.

Title: fix(faiss): pass numpy array instead of int to add_with_ids
Notes: FAISS add_with_ids received a scalar integer instead of an ID array.

Title: fix: skip disk devices in ComponentDevice.first_device
Notes: Device selection tried to construct a standalone DISK device from a valid offload map.

Title: fix: Add missing init param to to_dict in hf doc embedder
Notes: HuggingFaceAPIDocumentEmbedder serialization omitted configured concurrency_limit.

Title: fix: populate split_idx_start metadata in EmbeddingBasedDocumentSplitter
Notes: EmbeddingBasedDocumentSplitter omitted split_idx_start metadata from output documents.

Title: Fix postgresql dispose
Notes: PGVectorStore.close called session.close_all in a context requiring async greenlet handling.

Title: fix: strengthen deserialization allowlist checks to prevent bypass vulnerabilities
Notes: Pipeline deserialization checked declared paths rather than the resolved module and allowed a security bypass.

Title: Fix streaming reasoning conversion to preserve extra fields
Notes: Streaming OpenAI reasoning conversion discarded encrypted_content and other fields needed for later turns.

Title: fix openai tests hanging
Notes: OpenAI agent tests exposed an empty tool-call list that still made the agent loop indefinitely.

Title: Fix image url handling in Mistral AI
Notes: Mistral ImageURLChunk was constructed with url instead of image_url and raised ValidationError.

Title: fix: updating generated answer and extracted answers serialisation
Notes: GeneratedAnswer and ExtractedAnswer serialization used an incompatible dataclass shape.

Title: fix: avoid ValueError in ag-ui message conversion for multi-block ChatMessages
Notes: ag-ui conversion assigned to ChatMessage.content, which fails on multi-block messages.

Title: fix: Pass http_client & async_http_client to parent for OpenAILikeEmbedding
Notes: OpenAILikeEmbedding accepted HTTP clients but did not forward them to its parent.

Title: fix: MSGToDocument raises KeyError on ByteStream sources without file_path
Notes: MSGToDocument assumed ByteStream sources always had file_path metadata.

Title: fix: validate reserved MetadataRouter output name
Notes: MetadataRouter reserved output name caused an opaque TypeError during socket registration.

Title: Fix missing prompt in async MultiModalLLMProgram calls
Notes: Async multimodal program omitted prompt blocks from LLM call.

Title: fix(bedrock-converse): Only use guardrail_stream_processing_mode in streaming functions
Notes: Bedrock sent stream-only guardrail_stream_processing_mode to a non-streaming API.

Title: fix(azureaisearch): Add close/aclose methods to fix unclosed client session warnings
Notes: Azure AI Search clients created from index clients could leak HTTP sessions.

Title: fix: Replace raw SQL string interpolation with proper SQLAlchemy parameterized APIs in PostgresKVStore
Notes: PostgresKVStore interpolated SQL strings instead of parameterizing query construction; security risk.

Title: fix: BM25 Retriever allow top_k value greater than number of nodes added
Notes: BM25 top_k greater than corpus size was not bounded and could fail.

Title: fix(lancedb): fix metadata filtering logic and list value SQL generation
Notes: LanceDB metadata filter handling omitted prefixes for existing tables and mishandled list SQL values.

Title: fix(MilvusVectorStore): use primary key from milvus by its name instead of 'id'
Notes: Milvus hit IDs were read from literal id although primary key may use another name.

Title: fix: increasing telemetry event version to `Pipeline run (3.x)`
Notes: Pipeline telemetry event was still labeled 2.x instead of 3.x.

Title: Redis metadata filter fix
Notes: Redis vector store could not run metadata-only queries without a vector embedding.

Title: fix: prevent DoS attacks in JSONReader
Notes: JSONReader could hit recursion limits on deeply nested JSON without bounded handling.

Title: fix: add missing output sockes to LLM evaluators
Notes: LLM evaluators failed pipeline connections because declared output sockets were missing.

Title: fix(openai): make image_url detail optional in message dict
Notes: OpenAI message conversion always sent image detail auto, rejected by some compatible APIs.

Title: fix: clear stale metadata extraction errors after successful retries
Notes: Successful empty metadata extraction left stale error fields from a previous retry.

Title: fix resuming AgentWorkflow from ctx during hitl
Notes: Resuming HITL AgentWorkflow sent an extra start event rather than using saved context.

Title: fix: bedrock converse thinking block issue
Notes: Bedrock streaming did not expose thinking_delta for reasoning content.

Title: fix azure openai responses
Notes: Azure OpenAI Responses credential resolution broke expected inherited auth behavior.

Title: fix: avoid mutating Document.from_dict input
Notes: Document.from_dict modified the input mapping during deserialization.

Title: fix(google-genai): avoid mutating messages list in prepare_chat_params
Notes: Google GenAI parameter prep popped the system message from the caller list, losing it on retry.

Title: fix run stream llm request using ov genai will report std::runtime_error(ISSUE 20802)
Notes: OpenVINO GenAI streaming used APIs removed in the newer provider version.

Title: fix: Pin azure-ai-projects version to prevent breaking changes
Notes: Azure Foundry Agent dependency allowed incompatible azure-ai-projects v2 beta.

Title: fix: dont overwrite thought signatures
Notes: Gemini chat conversion overwrote existing thought signatures with None.

Title: fix(bedrock-converse): parse streaming tool_kwargs from string to dict
Notes: Bedrock streaming tool_kwargs stayed a JSON string rather than a dict.

Title: fix: preserve TreeSelectLeafRetriever source nodes
Notes: TreeSelectLeafRetriever discarded leaf source_nodes when returning a synthesized answer.

Title: fix: Update qdrant-client version constraints
Notes: Qdrant client upper bound prevents incompatible 1.16.0 API behavior.

Title: fix: fix async tool deserialization
Notes: Async decorated tool stores callable in async_function, but deserializer read only function.

Title: Fix/metadata serialization issue
Notes: An unnecessary metadata validation rejected serialized values and crashed.

Title: fix: raise ValueError when 'model' is passed instead of 'model_name' in BedrockEmbedding
Notes: BedrockEmbedding silently ignored model keyword rather than requiring model_name.

Title: fix: parse MistralAI structured ThinkChunk/TextChunk without regex
Notes: Mistral structured ThinkChunk/TextChunk handling dropped visible response text.

Title: fix: component tool schema description
Notes: ComponentTool parameters schema carried description at the wrong level.

Title: fix bedrock tests
Notes: Bedrock streaming handler validated prompt after response streaming began, so HTTPException propagated too late.

Title: fix: Fix HITL code raising a KeyError when tool name is hallucinated
Notes: HITL confirmation raised KeyError for a hallucinated tool name instead of a controlled tool error.

Title: fix!: resume a pipeline snapshot taken on a later loop visit
Notes: Pipeline snapshot resumption on a later loop visit used incorrect scheduler/state handling.

Title: fix(weaviate): use Filter.by_id() for node_ids query filter
Notes: Weaviate node_ids filtering used a nonexistent id property instead of Filter.by_id.

Title: fix: use Document.from_dict in InMemoryDocumentStore.load_from_disk
Notes: InMemoryDocumentStore loaded nested fields with Document constructor instead of from_dict.

Title: fix(nvidia-rerank): correct private attribute reference
Notes: NVIDIA reranker referenced api_key rather than its private _api_key attribute.

Title: fix(litellm): Handle missing tool call IDs with UUID fallback
Notes: LiteLLM tool calls without IDs needed a generated fallback ID to avoid agent failure.

Title: fix: ScrapflyReader Pydantic validation error
Notes: ScrapflyReader forward reference to ScrapflyClient was not resolved by Pydantic.

Title: fix bedrock converse empty tool config issue
Notes: Bedrock sent an empty tools config that its Converse API rejected.

Title: Azure api-key and azure-endpoint resolution fixes
Notes: Azure endpoint and API key resolution differed from working AzureOpenAI behavior.

Title: fix openai mimetype guess
Notes: OpenAI file input ignored an explicitly configured document MIME type.

Title: fix(qdrant): fix async collection creation using AsyncQdrantClient
Notes: Async Qdrant collection initialization failed when only AsyncQdrantClient was supplied.

Title: fix: skip None query input in QueryExpander
Notes: QueryExpander called strip on None or non-string pipeline input.

Title: fix(llms/fireworks): Cannot use Fireworks Deepseek V3.1-20006 issue
Notes: Fireworks DeepSeek v3.1 was missing from the model context mapping.

Title: fix: make aioboto3 optional in llama-index-llms-bedrock-converse
Notes: Required aioboto3 created dependency conflicts that prevented Bedrock Converse installation.

Title: fix: prevent RCE by hardening deserialization and Jinja sandbox
Notes: Safe-mode callable deserialization and Jinja custom filters allowed a pipeline to reach unsafe import primitives; taxonomy has no specific security symptom.

Title: Fix retriever KeyError when using FAISS
Notes: FAISS result IDs were used without resolving index node mapping, causing KeyError.

Title: Fix/make sure to stop agent on function tool return direct
Notes: Agent return_direct logic did not distinguish erroneous tool results from successful direct returns.

Title: fix(memory): ensure first message in queue is always a user message after flush
Notes: Memory flush could leave an assistant message first, violating provider conversation requirements.

Title: fix: Fix issues related to automatic logging set up in Haystack
Notes: Automatic Haystack logging reconfigured process-wide handlers and changed host application logs.

Title: fix: Handle tools=None in OpenAIResponses._get_model_kwargs
Notes: OpenAIResponses expanded tools=None with spread syntax and raised TypeError.

Title: fix: The classmethod of ReActChatFormatter should use cls instead of the class name
Notes: ReActChatFormatter classmethods hardcoded the base class and broke subclass construction.

Title: fix (opensearch): add close and aclose methods to vector client
Notes: OpenSearch vector clients lacked close methods, potentially leaking HTTP connections.

Title: fix: improve otel span ID handling
Notes: OpenTelemetry events lost the correct span ID in streaming generator context.

Title: fix: bound HWP section decompression
Notes: HWP reader used unbounded decompression, allowing excessive memory consumption.

Title: Fix: Raise NotImplementedError for unsupported Qdrant filter operators (#20237)
Notes: Qdrant silently ignored unsupported metadata operators and returned all documents.

Title: fix(dashscope): separate num_output from context_window to fix prompt…
Notes: DashScope model metadata equated output-token limit with context window, yielding negative available prompt space.

Title: fix: prevent AnswerBuilder from mutating input documents' meta
Notes: AnswerBuilder changed caller Document.meta in place while adding answer metadata.

Title: fix: Resolve AttributeError in CollectionParams.filter_fields access
Notes: Tencent vector store accessed missing public filter_fields instead of private field.

Title: fix: avoid SimpleWebPageReader and others to use url as a Document id
Notes: Web reader reused URL as Document ID, collapsing or conflicting with repeated pages.

Title: fix: raise FilterError on unknown metadata filter operators
Notes: Unknown metadata operator raised bare KeyError rather than a FilterError.

Title: fix: better Jinja2 Chat extension security
Notes: Jinja chat extension sandbox allowed unsafe content behavior; taxonomy has no specific security symptom.

Title: fix: prevent FileTypeRouter from mutating input ByteStream meta
Notes: FileTypeRouter mutated caller ByteStream metadata rather than making a copy.

Title: Bug Fix :- Not Able to Fetch Page whose latest is empty or null
Notes: ServiceNow page loader omitted single-version records whose latest field is empty.

Title: fix experimental and finetuning deps
Notes: Experimental integration depended on an incompatible finetuning version.

Title: Fix overwriting of LLM callback manager from Settings
Notes: Global Settings callback manager overwrote an LLM callback manager during resolution.

Title: fix: `OpenAIResponsesChatGenerator` filter streaming event fields from reasoning extra before call to Responses API
Notes: OpenAI reasoning extras retained event-only fields, which the next API request rejected.

Title: fix: use a private folder to store NTLK cache
Notes: NLTK cache was stored in a potentially accessible shared folder; security risk.

Title: fix: correct logging kwarg name in ToolInvoker serialization warning
Notes: ToolInvoker warning log placeholder used error while argument name was err.

Title: fix: handle Document with content=None in DocumentLanguageClassifier
Notes: DocumentLanguageClassifier attempted language detection on content=None.

Title: fix: MarkdownHeaderSplitter drops the leading header of an unsplit document
Notes: MarkdownHeaderSplitter removed leading header from a document that had not been header split.

Title: bug_fix: configuring resources from the mcp server correctly
Notes: MCP resource tool received resource.name instead of its URI; PR also supports resource templates.

Title: Fix: Respect cloud parameter when fetching child pages in ConfluenceR…
Notes: Confluence on-prem child-page fetch tried a cloud-only folder endpoint.

Title: fix: Milvus get_field_kwargs()
Notes: Milvus sparse setup called get_field_kwargs on the field rather than its embedding function.

Title: fix: Azure OpenAI embeddings' dependencies
Notes: Azure OpenAI embeddings dependency constrained newer compatible OpenAI integration version.

Title: Fix dashscope qwen assistant api Error response problem, extract tool_calls info from ChatMessage kwargs to top level.
Notes: DashScope assistant message omitted top-level tool_calls before tool result.

Title: fix(google-genai): skip model meta fetch when not needed
Notes: Google GenAI constructor fetched model metadata even when both values supplied, requiring an unnecessary external permission.

Title: fix(google-genai): keep images on Gemini function responses
Notes: Gemini function response serialization silently discarded image blocks returned by tools.

Title: fix: redact token from TokenSecret repr to prevent API key leaks
Notes: TokenSecret repr printed raw API tokens; taxonomy has no specific security symptom.

Title: fix(milvus): resolve issue with string_expr and filter precedence for…
Notes: Async Milvus aquery passed duplicate string_expr and mishandled filter precedence.

Title: fix: rotate the LinkContentFetcher user agent per fetch, not per component
Notes: LinkContentFetcher shared a user-agent rotation cursor across concurrent URL fetches.

Title: fix: fix non-deterministic Pipeline conversion for union in receivers
Notes: Pipeline union receiver conversion chose strategies nondeterministically.

Title: fix openai document block format
Notes: OpenAI document block fields were placed outside required nested file object.

Title: fix: serialize `timeout` and `max_retries` in `OpenAIImageGenerator.to_dict`
Notes: OpenAIImageGenerator serialization dropped timeout and max_retries settings.

Title: fix: resolve race condition in SQLAlchemyChatStore with precise timestamps (bug #19389)
Notes: ChatStore used second-resolution timestamps, allowing rapid messages to sort in wrong order.

Title: fix(core): Handle empty prompt in MockLLM.stream_complete
Notes: MockLLM streaming yielded nothing for an empty prompt, causing callback validation error.

Title: fix(llama-cpp): report the model's effective context window
Notes: LlamaCPP reported requested context size instead of actual size resolved by llama.cpp.

Title: Fix: Update OpenAI response type imports for latest openai library compatibility
Notes: OpenAI response event class was renamed upstream, causing an import failure.

Title: fix(nvidia-rerank): Fix POST request url for locally hosted NIM rerankers
Notes: NVIDIA reranker posted to base URL instead of local ranking endpoint.

Title: fix: correct log placeholder in pipeline breakpoint warning
Notes: Pipeline breakpoint warning passed pipeline_breakpoint though logging template expected break_point.

Title: fix: prevent command injection vulnerability in RAG CLI --clear flag
Notes: RAG CLI used interpolated shell command for cache clear, permitting command injection.

Title: fix(openai): sanitize generic Pydantic model schema names
Notes: Generic Pydantic tool names contained invalid brackets and OpenAI rejected function requests.

Title: fix: Fix appending `None` to a list in State when the source key is missing
Notes: ToolInvoker appended None to state when mapped tool output key was absent.

Title: fix(qdrant): add document to collection that doesn't exist
Notes: Async Qdrant collection creation did not mark collection initialized before adding nodes.

Title: fix: deferred annotation pickup in Agent
Notes: Agent inspection could not resolve deferred future annotations on tool parameters.

Title: fix: make primary key column configurable in DatabricksVectorSearch
Notes: DatabricksVectorSearch hardcoded doc_id despite configurable external primary key.

Title: Fix Gemini thought signature serialization
Notes: Gemini thought signature bytes could not be serialized in ChatMessage additional arguments.

Title: fix(chroma): pydantic validation error when using `retriever.invoke()`
Notes: Chroma returned None page content and retriever built an invalid Pydantic Document.

Title: fix: use `apostprocess_nodes()` in async retrieval paths
Notes: Async retrieval paths invoked sync postprocess_nodes instead of awaiting apostprocess_nodes.

Title: "fix: replace Mistral with MistralClient for mistralai>=2.0.0"
Notes: Mistral v2 changed import path of client class, causing ImportError in embeddings and LLM.

Title: fix: pinning openai and numpy
Notes: OpenAI 3.x conflicted with HTTP client compatibility; numpy pin also addresses dev type checks.

Title: fix: change ts_query definition to avoid double-stemming
Notes: Postgres sparse query double-stemmed some words and missed relevant documents.

Title: fix(azureaisearch): preserve falsy metadata values when indexing nodes
Notes: Azure AI Search indexing discarded valid falsy metadata values such as zero and false.

Title: Fix SQLi Vulnerability in SingleStore Db
Notes: SingleStore similarity SQL interpolated LIMIT and exposed SQL injection risk.

Title: fix: apply FilterPolicy.MERGE correctly in in-memory retrievers
Notes: In-memory retrievers treated MERGE filters as REPLACE and returned wrong documents.

Title: fix SelectionOutputParser when LLM chooses no choices
Notes: SelectionOutputParser mishandled empty LLM selection and assumed the wrong JSON shape.

Title: fix: validate modules during callable traversal
Notes: Callable deserialization failed to check every intermediate resolved object module, allowing sandbox escape.

Title: fix: update blob path in batch_update_index
Notes: Batch index upload omitted index prefix from blob path.

Title: fix(confluence): support Python 3.14
